summary: A complete offline Team Clash Practice loop on the original map Relay Station K-17: 6v6 against perception-limited bots on an authoritative 60 Hz room simulation, with nine weapons, attachments, perks, six equipment items, six Momentum support actions, a death recap, and results with XP, unlocks and Play Again.
notes: Single-player Practice only: the online netcode and services stack (WebSocket rooms, prediction and reconciliation, matchmaking) is not built, and the menu says so. The art is procedural primitives (no external assets). The URL flag ?autostart=1&demo=1 starts an autopilot attract match.
